content.title: When is national title game? Time, TV for Michigan-UConn basketball
content.text: Updated April 4, 2026, 11:43 p.m. ETMichigan basketball is one win away from a national championship.After defeating 1-seed Arizona in the national semifinal on Saturday, April 4, the 1-seed Wolverines will be facing 2-seed UConn in the national title game on Monday, April 6, at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.The Michigan-UConn game is scheduled for a start time of 8:50 p.m. ET, and will be on the TV channel TBS, with streaming available on Sling TV.After falling to Purdue in the Big Ten Tournament final, the Wolverines have notched five NCAA Tournament wins in a row to make it to the national championship game, with its most recent game coming against its toughest opponent. The Wildcats came into their Final Four matchup with Michigan as the No. 2 team in the country per KenPom, with the Wolverines ranked No. 1.Watch NCAA Tournament on Sling TVAnd now, the Wolverines have a chance to be crowned as national champions for the first time since 1989.Michigan has made it to the national final four times since its last championship in 1989, losing all four games. In fact, Michigan is 1-6 all time in national championship games dating back to its first appearance in 1965, most recently losing to Villanova in the 2018 national final.The Wolverines, who have looked like the most dominant team in the country for much of the tournament, are hoping to keep that trend going on Monday:Here's what we know so far about Monday's national championship game.Who does Michigan play in the national title game?The 1-seed Wolverines will play 2-seed UConn in the final of the 2026 NCAA Tournament after beating Arizona in the late game of the Final Four. UConn controlled Illinois, 71-62.When does Michigan play in the NCAA Tournament title game?Date: Monday, April 6.Time: 8:50 p.m. ET.Location: Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis.Channel: TBS.Streaming: On Sling TV.Watch NCAA Tournament on Sling TVMichigan NCAA Tournament scoresFirst round: W, 101-80 vs. 16-seed Howard.Second round: W, 95-72 vs. 9-seed Saint Louis.Sweet 16: W, 90-77 vs. 4-seed Alabama.Elite Eight: W, 95-62 vs. 6-seed Tennessee.Final Four, April 4: W, 91-73 vs. 1-seed Arizona.Championship, April 6: vs 2-seed UConn, 8:50 p.m. ET (TBS).Need to catch up on the news during your lunch break?
